stories.nhlSummary:

stories.headline: Preds Collecting Points But Far From Satisfied Through First Eight Games
stories.nhlSummary:
There are at least a few ways one could look at the Nashville Predators through the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign.
They’ve collected wins in just three of those contests - not the best, perhaps.
They’ve also accumulated points in six of those eight outings - certainly better.
